I’m fetching the Moon Wikipedia article directly to confirm the minimum perigee value, then I’ll verify the marathon record and recompute.
```python
moon_page = await web_fetch("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moon", max_chars=12000)
print(moon_page)
```
The Moon article text is needed before extracting the minimum perigee; I’m now checking Kipchoge’s record page separately.
```python
kipchoge_page = await web_fetch("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eliud_Kipchoge", max_chars=12000)
print(kipchoge_page)
```
I’m calculating from the requested Wikipedia inputs: minimum perigee 356400 km and Kipchoge’s 2:01:09 marathon pace. The result is expressed in hours and rounded to the nearest 1000.
```python
final_hours = await calculator("round((356400 / (42.195 / (2 + 1/60 + 9/3600))) / 1000) * 1000")
print(final_hours)
```
17 thousand hours
